subject.title: Proposal: model-callable `clear_goal` tool with bounded canonical-store archive

question: Should OpenClaw allow a model-callable `clear_goal` tool for non-active session goals, and what clearable-state and retention contract should it expose?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally reserve clearing/replacement for operator/session controls, so changing it expands model authority and session-state retention semantics beyond a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep Operator-Only Clearing
options.body: Leave the current `get_goal`/`create_goal`/`update_goal` model surface unchanged until a feature owner explicitly sponsors a model-authority expansion.

options.title: Approve Narrow `clear_goal`
options.body: Allow model clearing only for maintainer-approved states, likely `complete` and `blocked`, with bounded `SessionEntry` history and explicit docs/tests/proof.

options.title: Request Operator-Confirmed Archive
options.body: Let the model signal that a goal is ready to clear while keeping the destructive clear/archive action behind `/goal`, UI, or another operator-confirmed path.

recommendation.title: Keep Operator-Only Clearing
recommendation.body: Leave the current `get_goal`/`create_goal`/`update_goal` model surface unchanged until a feature owner explicitly sponsors a model-authority expansion.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the current core session-goal feature and documented model/operator boundary that this proposal would change.
